status: Bounded retrospective follow-up written before new estimator evaluation; all classes previously inspected. No independent confirmation or model promotion.
roster: Same74 rookies and14665 eligible charted rookie rushes from hash-verified official reconstruction.2023/2024 development45,2025 exploratory29. No new response-based filtering or source-availability exclusions.
target: Supplied charted player_get_off seconds, without redefining it as physiological reaction time. Primary squared mean forecast error per player, equal players; auxiliary equal-player mean squared play error retained. Contextual prediction conditions on observed NFL pre-snap circumstances, not an unconditional pre-draft forecast.
launch: PASS_RUSH_DRILL only. First3 consecutive recorded speed values>1yd/s define operational movement onset. Require contiguous10Hz timestamps within0.015s tolerance, finite nonnegative speeds/coordinates and recorded support through onset+0.5s with actual-time interpolation to that exact endpoint. Two fixed player-median fields: endpoint speed gain and Euclidean displacement over0.5s. Missing/rejected attempts remain missing, allplayers retained. No official start-cue or reaction measurement claimed.
conventional: Fixed existing full15/core8/motor4 source subsets, ridge0.1/1/10/100/1000/10000/mean. Select on raw player-mean get-off via3 inner whole-player class-stratified folds. Reuse that configuration for context-residual source baseline rather than tune on nuisance targets that could encode heldplayer responses. Shared Combine-position/drill/launch-availability indicators. No eventual NFL position.
context: FixedRidge10 on9 numeric fields down,yards_to_go,yardline_number,pre_snap_home_score,pre_snap_visitor_score,quarter,snap_depth,snap_width,snap_speed and3 categoricals lined_up_position,offense_formation,blitzing. Equal total player weights in response fit. Numeric preprocessing uses training plays only. Team/opponent/post-play fields and pressure outcomes excluded. These are operational recorded-context controls, not causal adjustment or evidence of intrinsic ability.
nuisance: Whole-player cross-fitted context responses. Complete context/source pipeline refitted excluding every correction-response player, including peer nuisance targets. Fixed raw-selected conventional config within each fitting boundary. Held-out labels and other held-out players cannot influence an individual's forecast.
correction: Two launch fields median-imputed/scaled and Ridge10-residualized against full conventional source design within training, clipped[-3,3]. Ridge10 without intercept fits cross-fitted player-mean context/source baseline errors. Add half correction capped at0.5 times SD of training-player mean rawgetoff seconds. No0–1 clipping for this real-valued target. Only exactzero versus fixed correction compared in3 inner whole-player folds; apply only when mean paired player loss gain exceeds one playerSE. This heuristic provides no guarantee of future gain.
evaluation: Three class-stratified4fold development repeats seeds714/914/1114. Average loss perplayer across repetitions; never count repeat appearances as independent. Temporal2023_to_2024 and exploratory2025 refit every transform using earlier trainingplayers only. Save all6controls:rawmean,rawconventional,context,contextualconventional,fixed,selected. No selection among reported outer results.
uncertainty: 4000 class-stratified paired-player resamples seed717 conditional on fitted predictions. Report pointwise95intervals with explicit omission of nuisance/refitting/researcher-selection/classshift/shared-game uncertainty. No duplicated-raw-row bootstrap refits in this release. No prospective success claim, optional stopping or new threshold after seeing outcomes.
scope: Official raw notebook rebuild is a reproducibility result. New get-off study is development of a different endpoint, not confirmation of prior pressure findings or sealed two-season2025 validation. Retain negative compact and broader residual findings. No Kaggle submission authorized by this experimental run.
decision: Retain conventional model unless genuinely independent later cohort supports incremental launch value. Report every failure, exact fallback, context-only comparison and both losses even if a point gain is favorable. Source launch/response correlation cannot by itself establish scouting advantage.
